 The present Revision has been filed against
the order dated 11.09.2014, passed by learned I I nd
Additional Civil Judge (Senior Division), Rudrapur,
District Udham Singh Nagar in Original Suit No.67 of
2013, "Sm t. Pyar Kaur and Others Vs. Power Grid
Corporation of I ndia Ltd. and Another", whereby issue
no.7 regarding valuation of suit property has been
decided against the revisionists-plaintiffs.
2 . Heard Mr. B.D. Kandpal, learned counsel for
the revisionists and Dr. Karitkey Hari Gupta, learned
counsel for the respondents.
1

2024:UHC:6659
3 . Dr. Karitkey Hari Gupta, Advocate, on
instruction from the respondents, submits that the
revisionists-plaintiffs have valued the suit property at
Rs.11,00,000/ -(Rupees Eleven Lakh), which is proper
and according to law.
4 . Therefore, with the consent of both the
parties, the present Revision (Civil Revision No.112 of
2014) is disposed of accordingly.
5 . The impugned order dated 11.09.2014
regarding valuation of suit property is set aside. The
valuation of the suit property is fixed at Rs.11,00,000/ -
.
